name: OB-Xm
author: Donmanouche

modules.name: OBXm Oscillator
modules.description: The two oscillators of OB-Xf (Surge Synth Team's continuation of OB-Xd), with its mixer, cross-modulation, hard sync, unison and detune. Same DSP code as OB-Xf.

modules.name: OBXm Filter
modules.description: The OB-Xf multimode filter (2-pole, 4-pole and 15 Xpander modes) with its filter envelope, curve and velocity. Same DSP code as OB-Xf.

description: OB-Xm: oscillator and filter modules for VCV Rack and the 4ms MetaModule, built from the GPL-3.0 DSP code of OB-Xf (https://github.com/surge-synthesizer/OB-Xf). Not affiliated with the Surge Synth Team.
